```{r}
## the three figures of the main text with their legends, read from the rendered manuscript so that they cannot drift from it
txt <- system2("pandoc", c(shQuote(here::here("01.manuscript/Manuscript.docx")), "-t", "plain", "--wrap=none"), stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE)
legend <- function(n) { x <- grep(sprintf("Figure[^0-9]{1,3}%d[:.]", n), txt, value = TRUE)[1]; if (is.na(x)) stop("legend of Figure ", n, " not found; render Manuscript.qmd first")
  x <- sub(sprintf(".*Figure[^0-9]{1,3}%d[:.][[:space:]]*", n), "", x); trimws(sub("[[:space:]|]+$", "", x)) }
fig <- function(n) { f <- here::here("01.manuscript", sprintf("Fig%d.png", n)); if (!file.exists(f)) stop("missing ", f); knitr::include_graphics(f) }
```

# Figure 1

```{r}
#| out-width: "100%"
fig(1)
```

Figure 1. `r legend(1)`
